text.title: Agency Risk Register Template — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the agency risk register as refreshed on a Monday: the agency's headcount, the 30-minute refresh with its three timed parts and overrun count, the concentration recompute from the trailing-90-day billing export with every client's share, at least one row in each of the six agency classes with the 8 columns (id, class, description, likelihood, impact, score, a named owner, an observable trigger) plus the class's quantified details (client share, key-person item with dated remediation, currency shares, contractor jurisdiction and test, pipeline months of coverage), a dated mitigation or a signed acceptance on every row at 15 or more, and the closed tab with close date and lesson. Validator at scripts/validate-agency-risk-register-template.py enforces it, including the Monday date, the timebox sum, score arithmetic, the 20 and 40 percent concentration rules, the coverage arithmetic and the in-week mitigation date.

required.field: `date` (a Monday), `minutes` {scores_update, top5_walk, action_note, total} with total at most 30, `consecutive_overruns`, `split_or_prune_required` true after two overruns, `action_note` (r-thirty-minute-monday)

`source` billing_export, `trailing_days` 90, `recomputed_on` = refresh date, `clients[]` each `name` and `share` of trailing-90-day revenue; every client above 20 percent has a row, every client at 40 percent or more scores at least 15 (r-concentration-90d-auto-score)

at least one row per class (revenue_concentration, key_person, fx_currency, contractor_classification, pipeline_thinness, regulatory), each `id`, `class`, `description`, `likelihood` 1-5, `impact` 1-5, `score` = likelihood x impact, `owner` (a person), `trigger`, `details` for the class, and `response` (mitigation with owner and due date this week, or acceptance signed by the founder) whenever score is 15 or more (r-six-agency-risk-classes, r-eight-column-row, r-key-person-bus-factor-dated, r-cross-border-rows-quantified, r-pipeline-months-of-coverage, r-score-15-action-or-signed-acceptance)

forbidden.pattern: a row whose `class` is not one of the six agency classes, or a class with no row — fm-01-project-rows-crowd-out
`concentration.source` other than the billing export, `trailing_days` other than 90, or `recomputed_on` not the refresh date — fm-02-concentration-estimated
a key-person row without `holder`, `remediation_owner` and a `deadline` date — fm-03-key-person-undated
a row scoring 15 or more with `response` null, a mitigation due outside the refresh week, or an acceptance without `signed_by` and `signed_on` — fm-04-silent-high-score
`owner` team, ops, everyone or empty, or a `trigger` shorter than an observable condition — fm-05-worry-without-trigger
`refresh.minutes.total` above 30, a total that is not the sum of the three parts, or two consecutive overruns without `split_or_prune_required` — fm-06-meeting-creep
a closed row without `closed_on` and `lesson` — fm-07-closed-rows-deleted

an FX row without revenue and cost shares by currency, a contractor row without jurisdiction, test and outcome, or a pipeline row whose `months_of_coverage` is not weighted pipeline over monthly cost (r-cross-border-rows-quantified, r-pipeline-months-of-coverage)

example.note: 2026-09-14 is a Monday and the three parts add to 28 minutes; concentration is recomputed that day from the billing export and Client A at 47 percent scores 4 x 5 = 20 with a mitigation due on Friday of the same week, while Client B at 22 percent has its own row; all six classes are present with 8 columns, a person as owner and an observable trigger; the key-person row is dated, the FX row carries shares by currency that add to 1, the contractor row names jurisdiction, test and outcome, and 210,000 over 60,000 is 3.5 months of coverage.

A Wednesday refresh of 60 minutes, two overruns without a split; concentration estimated over 365 days in June; Client A at 47 percent scoring 18 (not 4 x 5) with owner "team", trigger "if things get worse" and no response; a key-person row with no remediation owner or deadline; an FX row with no currency shares; a pipeline row whose 4 months is not 120,000 over 60,000; two project rows in classes that do not exist; no contractor or regulatory row.

list.item: `refresh.date` is a Monday, the three minute parts add to `total` and the total is at most 30; two consecutive overruns set `split_or_prune_required`.

`concentration` is the billing export over 90 days recomputed on the refresh date; every client above 20 percent has a revenue_concentration row with the same share, and every client at 40 percent or more scores at least 15.
All six classes have a row; every row has the 8 columns with `score` = likelihood x impact, a person as owner and an observable trigger; no project-level row is present.

Key-person rows carry item, holder, remediation owner and deadline; FX rows carry revenue and cost shares by currency that add to 1; contractor rows carry jurisdiction, test, outcome and a fix date when unresolved; pipeline rows carry weighted pipeline over monthly cost as months of coverage with a month threshold.
Every row at 15 or more has a mitigation due inside the refresh week or an acceptance signed by the founder with a date.
Resolved rows sit in `closed` with a close date and a lesson; nothing is deleted.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (Monday date, timebox sum and overrun, recompute date, 20 and 40 percent concentration rows, score arithmetic, currency shares, coverage arithmetic, mitigation due inside the week).
The same schema as a standalone file.
